content.text: This page was already close to compliant since it uses plain semantic HTML with no custom widgets — there was only one real defect. ## Defects found - **Missing `alt` attributes on all four `` elements** (3 photo thumbnails + 1 decorative divider) — a WCAG 1.1.1 violation. Screen readers would fall back to announcing the long `data:` URI as the accessible name, which is useless noise. ## Fix - Added `alt=""` to each `` and to ``. Each photo is purely decorative artwork (abstract shapes) whose meaning is already fully conveyed by the adjacent `
